narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Fine Leather Pants, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh! The pants? Ah, I realized shortly after writing this that I needed a full set of clothes - new overalls included. If it will get you out of my hair, I suppose I should honor the request. After all, you did make an arduous journey to find me. Take this, now please... <She gestured in a polite but firm shooing motion.>
narrative.requestItemsText: Move along, please, and try not to draw attention to us.
